research_question: Does a phase-preserving native-rate raw-RCG encoder recover beat timing that the magnitude-only WSST representation does not?
framing: This tests whether the TIMING INFORMATION EXISTS in a representation the pipeline has never used, rather than continuing to interpret failures of the existing one. WSST is np.abs(tx): a magnitude transform that discards phase, at 240 bins (33.3 ms) for a 1600-sample target. Raw rcg is the native 200 Hz time-domain signal with phase intact.
final_opportunity: This is the last continuous-route gate. Failure terminates the absolute-time continuous line and pivots the paper to a morphology-first task formulation.
task: R-peak heatmap ONLY: 1600-sample logits. NO ECG waveform reconstruction, no morphology head, no assembly.

arms.T0a_frozen_b1_event_head: The literal current baseline: event-head output of the frozen B1. Reported for continuity.
arms.T0b_wsst_event_only: CONTROL THAT ISOLATES THE VARIABLE. Same training recipe, budget, seed and output head as T1, but consuming WSST. Without this, a T1 gain would confound input representation with single-task-versus-multi-task training.
arms.T1_rcg_native_rate: Phase-preserving native-rate encoder over raw rcg (B,50,1600), stride-1 dilated stack, no early temporal downsampling, emitting 1600-sample logits.

why_T0b_matters: T0a was trained multi-task with a waveform loss; T1 is single-task. Comparing T1 only against T0a would not isolate the input representation.

protocol.split: repaired loso_v2, folds 1/5/9, validation subjects S2/S13/S29
protocol.supervision: TRAIN split only, Gaussian R-peak mask (sigma 4), BCE with logits
protocol.validation: inference consumes radar only; the validation ECG is opened solely to SCORE, and no validation lag is fitted on
protocol.budget: identical across T0b and T1: 80 epochs, patience 20, AdamW lr 1e-4 wd 1e-4, batch 16, seed 42+fold

metrics: failure rate = fraction of windows with no detected peak or F1 = 0
per-subject breakdown, no cross-subject mean beyond the required mean delta

must_all_hold: all 3 validation subjects improve in F1@50 relative to T0b
mean delta-F1@50 across the three subjects >= 0.10
S2's systematic offset disappears: its median signed error must fall to near zero rather than remaining a consistent ~65 ms shift
GATE.on_pass: Authorises T2 fusion and, subsequently, a continuous decoder. Each still needs its own spec.
GATE.on_fail: TERMINATE the absolute-time continuous route. Pivot the manuscript to a morphology-first task formulation. Do not propose further continuous-reconstruction architectures.

prohibitions: no ECG reconstruction in this experiment
no tuning after seeing validation numbers
